d: Bihar ke mantri ashok chaudhri ne patna ke e.en. kolej men asistent prophesar ki naukri join ki aur agle hi din chhutti (Lien) mang li. jab mamla rajabhvan pahuncha, to rajyapal ke apar mukhy sachiv IAS dipak kumar sinh ne is niyukti aur 'ophis oph prophit' par kare kanuni saval uthae. iske matr 4 din bad hi IAS dipak sinh ka tabadla kar diya gaya. ab khabar hai ki kanuni pachre se bachne ke lie ashok chaudhri ne prophesar pad se istipha de diya hai. 'lal batti' ke is episod men shubham ke sath janie is pure vivad ki kanuni aur rajnitik sachchaee.
